post.description:
Start here to find a model slug (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`) for get_model or list_model_providers, to rank models by intelligence, price or speed, or with `slug` to fetch one known model/effort row (legacy slugs included) without paging the whole table.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

include_deprecated.description: Include models the site marks deprecated. Since 2026-10-17 the leaderboard page serves only current models, so deprecated rows are usually absent and the result is reported as partial coverage. Implied true when `slug` is given.

limit.description:
Results per page (1-100).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

query.description: Case-insensitive terms matched against model name, short name, slug and creator; every whitespace-separated term must match (substring: `deepseek-v3` also matches `deepseek-v3-0324`; use `slug` for an exact row). Punctuation is folded on both sides, so `Claude Sonnet 5.5`, `claude-sonnet-5.5` and `claude-sonnet-5-5` find the same rows. One model per call: a list of several names matches nothing.

slug.description: Exact model slug at one reasoning effort (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`, `deepseek-v3`) or a pasted https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/{slug} URL: returns that one row (effort siblings such as `-high`/`-low` are not matched). Implies `include_deprecated: true`; a deprecated slug matches only while the page lists deprecated rows (use get_model for it otherwise). Combines with the other filters. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+$.
